description: Xiaomi’s Redmi Note 17 went from budget beast to a mid-range offering with some models even tapping into India’s premium segment. But given the ongoing memory crisis the brand is now making some tough decisions that make its newest mid-range difficult to recommend. While users can look forward to a new design and larger display, pretty much everything else falls short of expectations in our review.
title: Redmi Note 17 Review: Big Battery, Big Screen, but What About the Rest?

description: Amazon's ongoing sale has brought down the prices of several premium smartphones, including the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, Galaxy S26 5G, iQOO 15, Vivo V70 Elite 5G, Xiaomi 17T and OnePlus 13s. The OnePlus 13s has the lowest effective price in this selection at Rs. 56,999, while the Galaxy S25 Ultra sits at Rs. 89,999. Additional savings are available through bank offers, coupons and no-cost EMI on select listings, giving shoppers more ways to reduce their final purchase cost.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smartphones Under Rs 1 Lakh

description: Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms has entered a 20-year agreement to supply 191 megawatts of power from its Rockdale, Texas, facility to Anthropic, according to the company and a Bloomberg report. The deal could generate $9 billion (roughly Rs. 85,806 crore) in value and further accelerates the shift among Bitcoin miners towards AI infrastructure. Riot expects the initial deployment to begin in December 2027, with the full build-out scheduled for June 2028.
title: Bitcoin Miner Riot Platforms Enters $9 Billion AI Infrastructure Deal With Anthropic: Report

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is set to end tomorrow, and this is the last chance to avail discounts on popular smartphones. Premium smartphones from top brands are available at reduced prices during the sale. The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is currently listed at Rs. 89,999, down from Rs. 94,999. The Vivo X300 FE 5G is now listed for Rs. 89,999, instead of the actual price tag of Rs. 1,19,999.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Smartphone Deals From Leading Brands

description: Amazon's ongoing sale brings down the prices of several water purifiers from Aquaguard, Livpure, KENT and Pureit. The Aquaguard Blaze Insta Hot & Ambient is available for Rs. 19,997, while the Livpure Zinger Copper Hot costs Rs. 13,990. More affordable options include the Aquaguard Marvel NXT Active Copper at Rs. 9,999 and Pureit Wave Prime at Rs. 6,974. Eligible HDFC Bank discounts, coupons, exchange benefits and no-cost EMI options can further reduce the purchase cost on select listings.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Smart Water Purifiers

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is currently live for all shoppers in India. The discount sale, which started last week, offers deals, offers, and discounts on a wide range of large appliances. Those seeking an air fryer can find deals from brands like Philips, Agaro, and Prestige, among others. Some models are listed with coupon discounts, no-cost EMI offers and same-day delivery options.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Air Fryers

description: Alan Wake 2 has crossed 3 million copies sold across PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X nearly three years after its launch. Developer Remedy Entertainment announced the sales milestone in its latest financial report for the first half of 2026. Alan Wake 2 launch on PC and consoles on October 27, 2023.
title: Alan Wake 2 Has Crossed 3 Million Copies Sold Nearly 3 Years After Launch, Remedy Confirms

description: Acer announced the expansion of its Predator gaming laptop portfolio with the launch of three new models at the Next@Acer India 2026 event on Monday. The new Predator Helios Neo 16S AI, Predator Helios Neo 16 AI, and Predator Helios Neo 16 laptops are equipped with Intel processors, Nvidia GeForce RTX 50-series laptop GPUs and high-refresh-rate displays. Helios Neo 16 AI is the top-end model in the lineup, and features up to an Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX processor and a GeForce RTX 5080 GPU with 16GB of GDDR7 VRAM.
title: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16S AI, Helios Neo 16 AI, Helios Neo 16 Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra has been listed on the China Telecom website with the model number V2573A. According to the listing, the upcoming smartphone will be equipped with an unreleased octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9500M chipset with the model number MT6993M. The handset is listed with a 6.83-inch display. It could be offered in 8GB + 256GB, 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 256GB, and 16GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. On top of this, the China Telecom listing suggests that the iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will be equipped with a dual rear camera system, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter, coupled with an 8-megapixel secondary camera.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Full Specifications Leaked Ahead of China Launch; Dimensity 9500M, 9,100mAh Battery Tipped

description: iQOO Z11 is teased to come with a 6.8-inch curved AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate. It will be priced under Rs. 40,000 in India. It is teased to feature a 7,050mAh battery. The handset is scheduled to launch in India on August 20 and will be offered in Aurora Green and Celestial Blue colour options. It will run on the MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset.
title: iQOO Z11 India Price Teased Under Rs. 40,000 Ahead of August 20 Launch; Battery, Display Specifications Confirmed

description: The Vivo X500 series could feature distinct designs across its standard and Pro models. The regular X500 is tipped to use a 6.59-inch flat display and an upper-left circular camera module, while the Pro variants may feature centred camera units and 6.37-inch or 6.85-inch screens. Earlier leaks have also pointed to multiple cameras across the range, including 200-megapixel telephoto hardware on the X500 Pro Max. The series is expected to debut in September, although Vivo has not confirmed its launch plans.
title: Vivo X500 Series Design, Display and Camera Details Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Panasonic Lumix L10 fixed lens camera has been launched in India, the company announced on Tuesday. The fixed lens camera will go on sale in the country later this month via multiple retail channels. The new Panasonic Lumix L10 camera will be offered in two colourways, namely Black and Silver. The Panasonic Lumix L10 is equipped with a Leica DC Vario-Summilux lens with a 24mm to 75mm adjustable focal length. It also features an adjustable f/1.7 to f/2.8 aperture. The new camera also ships with support for macro photography. The Panasonic Lumix L10 also features Phase Hybrid Autofocus with 779 focus points. It also sports a 2.36-million-dot OLED viewfinder and a 1.84-million-dot free-angle monitor.
title: Panasonic Lumix L10 Fixed Lens Camera Launched in India With Phase Hybrid Autofocus: Price, Features

description: BTCPay Server has offered a reward of up to 3 Bitcoin, worth around $190,000 (roughly Rs. 1.8 crore), for information that helps recover funds stolen during last week’s attack. The project said the bounty is open even to the attackers and will pay 10 percent of the amount recovered. BTCPay is also rewarding researchers who identified the exploited vulnerability as investigations into the Lightning Network incident continue.
title: BTCPay Server Offers Up to 3 BTC Bounty to Recover Bitcoin Stolen in LND Attack

description: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026 is offering various gaming headphones under Rs. 10,000 at discounted prices. For reference, you can get the Razer Barracuda X at a relatively low price of Rs. 7,999, instead of its listed price of Rs. 14,999, resulting in a discount of about Rs. 7,000. Similarly, the HyperX Cloud III wireless headphones can be purchased at Rs. 9,476, coming down from their regular price of Rs. 11,428. You can also get an instant discount of 10 percent with an HDFC Bank credit card and credit EMI transactions.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on Gaming Headsets Under Rs. 10,000 From Razer, HyperX and More

description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is breaking records at the global box office, but the Hollywood blockbuster is also helping sales of Marvel's Spider-Man 2. Sony's action-adventure title has reportedly sold 316,000 copies on PS5 and PC since Brand New Day released in theatres on July 30.
title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 Has Reportedly Sold Over 300,000 Copies Since Spider-Man: Brand New Day Released

description: OpenAI announced the GPT‑5.6‑Cyber model, available through Daybreak Red access. It is designed to handle advanced cybersecurity tasks with fewer refusals. The company states that it has conducted an internal test and outperformed its general-purpose models. The company offered GPT-5.6-Cyber access to trusted customers, who used the model to improve their defensive cybersecurity workflows. The early-access partners included SpecterOps, SentinelOne and Palo Alto Networks.
title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6-Cyber Model Through Daybreak to Strengthen Cyber Defence

description: The Noise Clutch HP-P01 is a new gaming headphone designed for use across PCs, consoles and mobile devices. It features a 50mm dynamic driver, detachable cardioid microphone and 7.1 virtual surround sound. The headset supports 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth 6.0 and 3.5mm wired connectivity, with a claimed 24ms latency. A 600mAh battery provides up to 40 hours of playback with RGB disabled. Other features include a full-metal frame, fabric-covered cushions, RGB lighting and compatibility with multiple gaming platforms.
title: Noise Clutch HP-P01 Gaming Headphone Launched in India With 50mm Driver, Up to 40 Hours Battery Life: Price, Features

description: With Independence Day on the horizon, the Amazon Great Freedom Sale in India brings discounts on a wide range of products across categories. Shoppers can avail of price cuts, bank offers, and other benefits to purchase the products from their wishlist at considerably lower prices than the usual market rates. If you’ve been looking for a new pair of true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds without burning a hole in your pocket, then the sale event brings lucrative deals on options from Oppo, Samsung, OnePlus and more, priced under Rs. 3,000.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Best Deals on TWS Under Rs. 3,000

description: Redmi K100 Pro and Redmi K100 Pro Max have been launched in China as the company's new flagship smartphones. The new smartphones are now on sale in China via the Xiaomi online store. The Redmi K100 Pro is offered in Black, Cabernet Sauvignon, Fireflies Chasing the Light, and White (translated from Chinese) colour options, while the Redmi K100 Pro Max is available in Black, Cabernet Sauvignon Red, Chasing the Wind Blue, and Flowing Gold and White (translated from Chinese) colourways. The Redmi K100 Pro features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V chipset and an 8,580mAh battery.
title: Redmi K100 Pro Max and Redmi K100 Pro Launched With 185Hz AMOLED Display, 200-Megapixel Camera: Price, Features

description: Dyson announced the launch of its limited-edition Ceramic Khaki colourway in the Dyson Airwrap i.d. in India. The new colour variant of the multi-styler and dryer is currently available for purchase through the company's India website and Dyson stores for Rs. 49,900. The Dyson Airwrap i.d. offers Bluetooth connectivity. This 6-in-1 styling device is compatible with the MyDyson app. It has a rated power consumption of 1,300W.
title: Dyson Airwrap i.d. Hair Styler Launched in New Ceramic Khaki Colour in India

description: Apple is planning a major design overhaul for its rumoured 20th anniversary iPhone Pro models, according to a Bloomberg report citing people with knowledge of the matter. The Cupertino-based tech giant might bring a new “glass-centric” design with its 20th anniversary iPhone. The report contradicts earlier predictions that suggested that the tech giant had cancelled its plans to launch a glass iPhone model. The new glass-centric design will reportedly be found on iPhone Pro and iPhone Pro Max models next year, internally codenamed V73 and V74.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans a Glass-Centric Design Overhaul for the 20th Anniversary iPhone Pro Models

description: More people are pre-ordering the pricier Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6, according to Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick. The Take-Two boss said in a new interview that GTA 6 pre-orders had exceeded expectations. Ultimate edition of the game costs $99.99, while Standard edition costs $79.99.
title: More Users Are Pre-Ordering GTA 6's $100 Ultimate Edition, Says Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is expected to arrive with a 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, Exynos 2500 chipset and 8GB of RAM. The phone could offer 128GB and 256GB storage options and run Android 17-based One UI 9. Other reported specifications include a 50-megapixel main camera, 4,900mAh battery and 45W charging. Samsung may launch the handset in Graphite, Pistachio and Blueberry finishes in early September, with a reported European price of EUR 799 (roughly Rs. 88,000).
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Full Specifications Leaked Ahead of Expected September Launch

description: Crypto exchange Coinsbuy suffered losses exceeding $8 million after a suspected attacker targeted wallets across the TRON and Ethereum blockchains. The hacker drained more than $6 million in stablecoins from eight TRON wallets and moved additional USDT and Ether from three Ethereum wallets. Most of the stolen assets were subsequently routed through crypto swapping and exchange services. Coinsbuy said no customers suffered losses and that the platform remains operational while investigations continue.
title: Crypto Exchange Coinsbuy Loses Over $8 Million in Coordinated Cross-Blockchain Attack

description: The Xiaomi 18 series is rumoured to debut in September as the company’s next-generation flagship numbered series. In recent months, the rumour mill has already revealed details about the purported handsets, including their form factor, display and battery capacity. A fresh leak has now shed light on the possible colour options of the standard Xiaomi 18. As per a tipster, the purported Xiaomi handset could be offered in five colourways.
title: Xiaomi 18 Colour Options Tipped Ahead of China Launch; May Retain Square Camera Module

description: Asus and Lenovo’s upcoming Googlebook models have surfaced in leaked images. The purported renders offer an early look at their designs. The laptops appear to feature a slim form factor and a distinctive glow bar integrated into the lid. It could work like the HiLight feature available on the Pixel 11 series. They appear to include multiple connectivity ports. Asus Googlebook is shown in carbon grey colour, while the Lenovo Googlebook appears in a light grey shade.
title: Googlebook Laptops From Asus and Lenovo Leak in Renders Ahead of Official Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G has surfaced on Geekbench with a MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, 4GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. The benchmarked phone scored 745 points in single-core testing and 2,073 points in multi-core testing. Its listing also shows Android 17 with One UI 9, potentially making it an early non-flagship Samsung phone with the software. Earlier CAD renders have suggested a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display, a 90Hz refresh rate and a design similar to the Galaxy A17.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Specifications Ahead of Launch

description: The Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint gets a tracker built into the leather personalisation tag itself. It works with both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub, which means no separate accessory or no extra app to remember. It costs roughly Rs. 1,500 more than the equivalent non-Waypoint Zipprix FT, and full tracking precision depends on Apple/Google's crowd-sourced device network rather than dedicated GPS or (for now) Ultra-Wideband.
title: Samsonite Zipprix FT Waypoint Review: Solves the "Where's My Luggage" Problem With Built-In Tracking

description: Vivo X300 FE price in India has been increased significantly. The company has updated its online store in the country to reflect the new prices for both storage options. The handset is on sale in India in 12GB + 256GB and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. It is offered in Lilac Purple, Noir Black, and Urban Olive colour options. The new hike comes as the prices of memory and storage components, such as DRAM and NAND sticks, continue to rise as OEMs have shifted their supply to cater to the needs of AI data centres. Apart from Vivo, OnePlus, Oppo, Realme, and iQOO have also increased the prices of their phones in the past.
title: Vivo X300 FE Price in India Hiked Again Amid Rising Memory Costs

description: Bitcoin slipped below Rs. 62 lakh as investors turned cautious ahead of key US economic data. Recent ETF outflows, rising oil prices, and subdued market participation weighed on sentiment, while larger holders continued accumulating Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $65,000 Ahead of US Inflation Data; Ethereum, Major Altcoins Trade Lower

description: The Pixel Watch 5 Stephen Curry Edition is expected to arrive as a 45mm LTE model with a custom woven band. The leaked version reportedly carries a EUR 579.99 (roughly Rs. 63,900) price tag in Europe and could go on sale around August 20. Google is also expected to limit its availability to select markets and sell it while supplies last. The watch will reportedly retain the core specifications of the standard Pixel Watch 5, including 64GB storage, Wear OS 7.0 and a 465mAh battery.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Stephen Curry Edition Leaked Ahead of August 12 Launch Event

description: Meta has announced Muse Glimmer. This latest AI model from Meta Superintelligence Labs has the model weights under a permissive Apache 2.0 license. It is a 30-billion-parameter model optimised for always-on local agent workflows, and it can work on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. This would enable use cases including local agents and function calling, local coding, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Meta says Muse Glimmer has been trained on data covering more than 100 languages.
title: Meta Launches Muse Glimmer AI Model for Local Coding, Agentic Tasks and Multi-Step Reasoning

description: YouTube has updated its Partner Program policies, the company announced on Monday. The company says that in 2027 it expects to pay “even more to creators” than it did in 2026. As part of the updates, the company has revised the requirements for new creators who wish to apply to be part of the YouTube Partner Program. Scheduled to come into force on February 1, 2027, YouTube says that new creators applying to be part of the partner program must have 8,000 qualified watch hours in the last year or 20 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days. The tech firm highlighted that its entry thresholds for Fan Funding and shopping products have not been changed.
title: YouTube Partner Program Entry Thresholds Updated With Higher Requirements for New Creators

description: 1666 Amsterdam, the upcoming action-adventure game from Assassin's Creed co-creator Patrice Désilets, will launch in early access on PC later this month. The game is coming to Steam and Epic Games Store on August 25, developer Panache Digital Games has announced.
title: 1666 Amsterdam, Assassin's Creed Creator's Next Game, Will Launch in Early Access on PC This Month

description: Arnold Su, Vice President, Consumer and Gaming PC, System Business Group, ASUS India, explains why the company is entering the tablet market, how it plans to deal with rising PC prices, why gaming remains its biggest growth engine, and why he believes India's smaller towns could hold the key to ASUS's next phase of growth.
title: Asus Targets No. 1 Position in India This Year: VP Arnold Su on Tablets, Pricing, and More

description: The Redmi Note 17 was launched in India earlier this month, and the company is believed to have a busy few months ahead. A tipster claims that the Redmi 17 series could launch as soon as next month. Meanwhile, the Redmi Note 17 could get a second model in the form of the Redmi Note 17 Pro. The bigger launch, however, could be the Xiaomi 18 Pro series, which is tipped to arrive by December.
title: Xiaomi 18 Series, Redmi Note 17 Pro Lineup India Launch Date Tipped; Redmi 17 Could Launch Next Month

description: The Made by Google event is just days away, where the Pixel 11 series is expected to be unveiled. Google’s next-generation flagship lineup is expected to comprise four models — Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, with all of the variants being powered by the Tensor G6 chipset. Ahead of the launch, a Pixel handset has surfaced on a benchmarking site, revealing CPU details along with the performance numbers.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Geekbench Listing Reveals Tensor G6 Performance, 16GB of RAM

description: The Google Pixel 11 series is all set to be unveiled at the Made by Google event on August 12. Ahead of their anticipated debut, alleged hands-on images of the Pixel 11 Pro XL have now surfaced online. It appears to have the familiar Pixel design, while introducing the new notification light. Meanwhile, a retail box also reveals another colour option of the purported handset. Google has also teased both shades of the Pixel 11 Pro XL in a recent social media post.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Alleged Hands-On Images Leak, Revealing Matte Black, Dune Colourways
